rules.scoring: Five factors scored 1-5 each, 18 of 25 is the bar. Quality: ROIC (ROE for financials/REITs/utilities), operating margin, net debt/EBITDA, FCF conversion. Growth: long-term EPS growth, bumped by forward revenue growth over 20%. Valuation: PEG, penalized above 15x sales. Estimate momentum: Zacks Rank and 4-week change in F1/F2 consensus. Durability: moat, customer concentration, regulatory and cycle exposure (judgment, reason written next to it).
rules.construction: Core names need durability of 3 or better; durability 2 (commodity, extreme cycle, single-customer) only enters a 3-name cyclical sleeve. Tech capped at 9 names, wafer-fab equipment at 3, memory at 1. Scores pick the names; correlation sets the weights: a high-scoring name whose bet is already held is sized at 2%.
rules.sizing: Tier A 5-6%, Tier B 4%, Tier C 2%. Sector floor of 2 names where candidates score 16+. AI-capex beneficiaries capped at 50%; winners get trimmed back under the cap rather than ridden up.
rules.cadence: Re-score weekly (Sunday script). Hard triggers act the week they fire: Zacks Rank 4-5, F2 consensus cut more than 5% in 60 days, or the stated sell trigger. Everything else (weights, swaps, tiers) batches to the monthly review. Theses re-read quarterly; hyperscaler capex guidance (MSFT, GOOG, AMZN, META) checked at each quarterly review as the demand signal for the AI-capex half.
rules.data: Zacks Rank and style data come from chat reviews and are stored here; the Sunday script refreshes FMP prices, fundamentals and estimates and recomputes quality, growth and valuation. Every name still goes through the firm's research before any client sees it. Information for advisor use, not a recommendation.
